requested_by: ECR, The Left, ESN, PfE, S&D
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text: Calls on the Member States to immediately lift restrictions on the use of Western weapons systems delivered to Ukraine against legitimate military targets on Russian territory, as this hinders Ukraine’s ability to fully exercise its right to self-defence under international public law and leaves Ukraine exposed to attacks on its population and infrastructure;
